Description: CloudWatch Dashboards to visualize EventBridge Pipes resources. Both dashboards leverage Dashboard Variables to filter on the desired resources. Dashboard 'ALB_All_Resources' visualizes ALL ALB resources in the target region. Dashboard 'ALB_Individual_Resources' provides additional filters to isolate a specific ALB and the corresponding Web Application Firewall (WAF).

DefaultRegion.Description: Select the default region hosting the EventBridge Pipes to be monitored.

DefaultPipe.Description: Optional. Select the default EventBridge Pipe to be monitored.
